service.title: Service Management
service.installed: The service was installed and started.
service.upgraded: The service was upgraded and restarted.

config.noNodesHint: Nodes come from an invite. Import one to start routing domains.
config.multipleNodesHint: Multiple nodes are supported; the same domain can be configured on several nodes for load balancing
config.overviewHint: Shows the unique domains configured across all nodes, {count} in total
config.dnsStrategyHint: What happens to this machine's name resolution while the tunnel is up. Scoped points only the configured domains at the tunnel and leaves the rest — an internal zone, another tunnel's names — where they were; global points every query at it; none touches the machine's DNS at all, and the tunnel's own resolver still runs for a PAC file or a hosts entry to point at. The strategy is never changed for you: a machine that cannot be scoped says so rather than having its whole DNS replaced.
config.strategyRoundRobinDesc: Distribute requests to each node in turn
config.relayModeHint: Configure the iroh relay forwarding mode
config.relayUrlHint: Required, and used on its own — no N0 relay. Applies on the next start.
config.relayAuthTokenHint: Only if the relay requires one. The server needs the same token.

settings.credentialProtectionKeychain: Encrypted, key held by the system keychain
settings.credentialProtectionFile: Encrypted, key kept in a private file
settings.tunDeviceNameHint: Virtual network interface name (auto-assigned on macOS; ignored there)
settings.launchAtStartupHint: Start the app when you log in
settings.autoConnectHint: Bring the tunnel up by itself after a restart
settings.silentStartHint: Come up in the tray without a window at login
settings.minimizeOnCloseHint: Minimize to the system tray when the close button is clicked

settings.logLevelHint: Controls the verbosity of log output

invite.title: Add a node from an invite
invite.description: Paste a nexapipe:// link: the output of the server's --generate-invite command, or one that was shared with you.
invite.name: Name
invite.relayHint: Applies to every node, not just this one
invite.applyRelay: Also use it as this machine's relay
invite.twoFactorHint: Fills in the client ID and secret for this endpoint only
invite.enrollmentHint: A one-time token: the server issues this endpoint's credentials when it first connects, and the token stops working
invite.alreadyPresent: Already in the list — importing merges its domains into that node.
invite.added: Added the node from the invite.
invite.merged: Merged the invite into the existing node.
invite.enrolled: Enrolled as {client} and saved the credentials it was issued.

node.connectionHint: Nodes come from invites, so the target cannot be changed here.
node.twoFactorHint: Must match this server's [auth.clients] entry. Leave it off for a server that has no 2FA.
node.deviceNone: unnamed — this machine is answering with the client's own secret
node.deviceHint: A named device gets a secret of its own, so revoking it leaves every other device of this client alone. Naming one takes a registration invite: a token is what issues a credential, and a secret typed by hand is the client's.
node.enrollmentPending: Waiting to enroll as {id}: the server issues this node's credentials on the next connect.
node.twoFactorKeyHint: This node proves itself with a key of its own. The private half never leaves this machine, and the server holds only the public half above — so this node can be revoked on its own, and a leaked configuration is no longer a way in as it.

gate.lockedBody: Confirm it is you to show and edit what this machine connects through — nodes, connection strings, two-factor secrets and the relay. The page shuts itself again after two minutes.
gate.unavailableShort: This device cannot confirm it is you
gate.unavailableTitle: This device cannot confirm it is you
gate.unavailableBody: Showing a credential here asks this device to confirm who is using it first, and it has nothing to ask with — no password, no fingerprint, nothing set up to check against. Credentials stay hidden until that changes.
gate.reasonConfig: Show and edit this machine's proxy configuration
gate.notConfirmed: This device did not confirm it is you.
